dialogue_segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
dialogue_segments.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Arrogant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.

dialogue_segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Tense, Solemn)
dialogue_segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
dialogue_segments.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive, Masking Panic)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Then let it remain a rumor.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The Former Groom, soaked from the rain and clutching his hat, walks nervously through the double doors into the study.

camera_segments.text: Wide shot of an opulent gothic manor study. The Blond Nobleman sits in a velvet armchair beside a roaring fireplace, reading an open leather-bound book.

camera_segments.text: Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

camera_segments.text: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.

camera_segments.label: CAMERA
camera_segments.text: Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.
